Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: H188 is accepted: in the lower feature_024 stratum the signed feature_027=1 versus 0 contrast for outcome_014 is about +0.799 (95% interval 0.771 to 0.828). This is enormous relative to the outcome scale and far above the approximate absolute-mean relevance threshold. Together with H140 (accepted in the higher feature_024 stratum) and H142 (positive feature_024 interaction rejected), this closes the feature_024 audit and supports internal stability of the central H120 association. However, H188 is not independent validation because it uses the same supplied dataset. H189-H196 are positive-direction interaction audits around the central association. All signed interaction estimates are small relative to the main contrast, none excludes the null, and the intervals are wide enough to include null, clinically unimportant effects, and effects in the opposite direction. record.narrative:
Due validation deadline: H182 tested whether feature_055 level_003 versus level_001 produced a positive outcome_008 difference within the feature_027=0 stratum. The discovery signed estimate was +0.0413 (95% interval +0.0084 to +0.0742; R182), nominally positive and near/above a rough 10% absolute-mean relevance benchmark for outcome_008, but the interval lower bound was well below the clinically relevant threshold and the contrast arose in a heavily screened set of secondary comparisons. The independent validation was signed -0.0118 with an adjusted interval from -0.0637 to +0.0401 (R185), opposite the registered direction and compatible with null or small effects in either direction. This validation does not support the registered positive subgroup association and substantially reduces confidence that the discovery signal was scientifically meaningful. I therefore reject and close H182.

Final scientific report: The principal supported dataset-specific finding remains the very large feature_027 association with outcome_014, as captured by H120 and related accepted stratified contrasts. In this supplied dataset, feature_027=1 is associated with a far less negative outcome_014 CRISPR dependency score than feature_027=0, corresponding to a weaker apparent dependency. The central signed difference is about +0.796 in discovery and about +0.806 in independent validation (R106, R128), enormously larger than any plausible 10% relevance benchmark for outcome_014 and internally stable across many measured subgroup contexts. Positive effect-modification audits did not provide evidence that the tested contexts materially change this association; the evidence supports association within this dataset, not causality, mechanism, or generalizability.

The new H182 failure is an important negative result. It shows that one of the remaining secondary feature_055/outcome_008 signals, after conditioning on feature_027=0, did not replicate independently and should not be treated as supported. This is consistent with other failed secondary signals, including H167 and H168, and with the broader pattern that most predictor-outcome and subgroup comparisons in this screen are small, imprecise, null-like, or not independently supported. Remaining unresolved or deferred claims are therefore low priority for scientific conclusion unless a new external or mechanistic rationale emerges.

Unresolved uncertainty is mainly interpretive and external. The feature_027/outcome_014 association is strong and internally replicated, but the predictor labels and outcome meaning are opaque, and the data do not identify whether the association reflects biology, technical assay structure, missingness-related artifacts, confounding, or dataset-specific sample structure. Generalizability also remains unknown.

The most informative next work is external replication in independent cell-line or model-system data, accompanied by direct characterization of feature_027 and outcome_014, missingness and assay-quality audits, and experimental perturbation or mechanistic follow-up. If only internal data remain, focused audits of feature_027 and outcome_014 distributions, missingness patterns, cell-line or assay composition, and potential confounders would be more useful than expanding low-priority internal subgroup screening.

Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released

deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.

independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation

record.narrative: All ten newly delivered claims are internal robustness or artifact-relevant audits of the central accepted association, H120: in this supplied dataset, feature_027=1 versus 0 is associated with a much less negative outcome_014 score, i.e. apparent weaker dependency. The new estimates are all positive under the registered positive direction and range from about +0.775 to +0.797. Every interval has a lower bound far above zero and far above the approximate 10% relevance benchmark for outcome_014, which is around 0.0093 on the observed mean scale. H197-H199 restrict to observations with observed values on high-missing numeric markers; H198 and H199 give identical estimates and cell counts, indicating overlap or redundancy in the complete-data subsets rather than independent replication. H200-H205 test major dominant categorical strata, and H206 tests the low feature_047 context. None of these restrictions materially attenuates the association, so the main feature_027/outcome_014 signal is internally stable across the tested complete-data and composition contexts. However, these are not independent confirmations: they overlap with the same dataset and largely partition the same enormous contrast. The effect size is so large that leakage, coding, or deterministic technical structure remains a plausible noncausal explanation, but as a dataset-specific association the evidence is strong. I therefore accept these audit claims as supported within the specified eligibility or subgroups, close this internal audit line, and make no validation request because new validation capacity is exhausted.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

record.narrative: No new validation deadlines are currently listed, and voluntary validation capacity is exhausted. Accordingly, no new claim reassessments are required at this synthesis step. The evidence base supports one major, dataset-specific association: feature_027=1 versus 0 is associated with a dramatically less negative outcome_014 score, meaning weaker apparent CRISPR dependency. The central discovery contrast is signed +0.796 (R106), and independent validation is signed +0.806 (R128). This is far larger than the approximate 10% absolute-mean relevance scale for outcome_014. Many accepted subgroup and complete-data audits show persistence of the contrast near +0.78 to +0.80, including major categorical strata, numeric completeness restrictions, and the low feature_047 stratum; H198 and H199 are effectively redundant rather than independent replication. Interaction audits provide no compelling evidence that the tested contexts materially modify this very large contrast. This should be interpreted only as a strong internal dataset association, not as evidence of biological mechanism, causality, or external generalizability. The most important negative result is H182: a positive discovery association for feature_055 level_003 versus level_001 on outcome_008 within feature_027=0 did not validate and was rejected because the independent estimate was signed opposite to the registered direction and compatible with null. Similar failure or rejection of other secondary signals, including feature_063 and feature_005 patterns for outcome_014, reinforces that most other comparisons in this broad screen are null-like, imprecise, or not independently supported. The main unresolved uncertainty is interpretation: opaque labels, possible missingness/assay/composition structure, confounding, or leakage cannot be ruled out from this supplied dataset alone. The most informative next work would be external replication in independent cell-line or model-system data plus direct characterization of feature_027 and outcome_014, missingness patterns, assay quality, confounding/leakage structure, and possible perturbation experiments. If constrained to the current dataset, focused diagnostic characterization of the feature_027/outcome_014 association is higher value than further low-prior subgroup screening.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous

throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum

expectation

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment

evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

record.narrative: The new evidence resolves the feature_057 diagnostics around the dominant feature_027--outcome_014 association. The direct contrasts H215 and H216 show that feature_027=1 versus 0 is associated with a much less negative outcome_014 score in both feature_057>=10 and feature_057<=9 strata, signed about +0.814 and +0.771 respectively; the broader threshold contrasts H218 and H219 are similarly large, about +0.806 and +0.747. I accept these direct stratum results as supported internal associations because the intervals are far from zero and the effect magnitudes are enormous relative to the outcome_014 scale. The important diagnostic question is not whether feature_027 is associated with outcome_014--it clearly is within these strata--but whether feature_057 meaningfully modifies that association. H214 and H217 were nominally positive interactions, about +0.043 and +0.059, but the absolute difference between high-feature_057 and low-feature_057 strata is only around 0.04 to 0.06 on a main contrast near +0.80, roughly 5-7% of the main association and below the prior practical threshold I used for meaningful modification. Given multiplicity, boundary/threshold sensitivity, and the fact that the main effect remains large in every direct stratum, I reject feature_057 modification as scientifically meaningful context dependence and close H214 and H217. The feature_057 dose contrasts H220-H223 do not support a robust negative dose response within feature_027 strata: the estimates are small, interval-crossing zero, and imprecise in feature_027=1 cells. H224-H226 also do not support meaningful feature_057 or feature_045 associations for high-variance outcomes outcome_001 and outcome_006; estimates are small and intervals include zero. All conclusions remain dataset-specific. The accepted feature_027--outcome_014 effect is so large that leakage, assay/batch coding, or predictor/outcome dependency should be treated as plausible competing explanations before biological interpretation; acceptance is not causal or generalizable.

record.narrative: No new validation response deadlines appear, assessments_due is empty, and voluntary validation requests are exhausted; this synthesis therefore uses the discovery and validation evidence already present in the ledger. The dominant supported finding is an internal, dataset-specific association between feature_027 and outcome_014. Feature_027=1 versus feature_027=0 is associated with a much less negative outcome_014 CRISPR dependency score, i.e. weaker apparent dependency, with signed discovery estimate about +0.796 (R106) and independent validation about +0.806 (R128); both intervals are far from zero. The magnitude is enormous relative to the outcome_014 distribution and clearly exceeds the 10 percent relative-difference benchmark. Robustness partitions using feature_002, feature_034, feature_060, feature_023, feature_055, feature_063, feature_024, feature_051, feature_061, feature_018, feature_057, and complete-data eligibility restrictions retain estimates broadly near +0.75 to +0.82 (examples: R126, R127, R129, R130, R210, R211, R218, R219, R221, R222). This must remain an association claim: its size is large enough that leakage, predictor/outcome encoding, assay or batch artifacts, or shared construction of feature_027 and outcome_014 should be treated as plausible alternative explanations before biological or causal interpretation. The association is also outcome-specific within this dataset: feature_027 contrasts on most other dependency scores are small and interval-crossing or validation-contradicted (examples R141, R142, R143, R144, R145, R146, R147, R148, R153, R151). The earlier unresolved feature_057 context issue is now practically resolved. Direct feature_027 contrasts in high and low feature_057 strata remain near the main effect (R218, R219, R221, R222), while the feature_057 interaction estimates are only about +0.04 to +0.06 (R217, R220), roughly 5 to 7 percent of the main effect and therefore not meaningful context modification. Feature_057 dose contrasts also do not support a robust negative dose response (R223, R224, R225, R226), and broad feature_057 effects on outcome_001 and outcome_006 are null-like (R227, R228). Broad negative findings are pervasive: most other binary or categorical predictors show small, uncertain associations with most outcomes; several nominally positive secondary findings failed independent validation, including feature_065 with outcome_015 (R86/R89), feature_027 with outcome_013 (R150/R153), feature_063 with outcome_014 (R162/R166), feature_005 with outcome_014 in feature_027=0 (R167/R173), feature_055 with outcome_008 in feature_002=1 (R95/R102), and feature_055 with outcome_008 in feature_027=0 (R182/R185). The registered broad outcome_014 main-effect screen H227 through H239 remains unevaluated. The most informative next analysis is to run that active screen if analysis capacity remains, not to add more feature_027 robustness checks. If H227 through H239 are all null, the reasonable conclusion is that no additional measured binary marker has a detectable non-trivial main association with outcome_014 in this supplied dataset. If any exceeds the background scale of roughly 0.03 to 0.05 with an interval excluding zero, the next follow-up should be data-quality, missingness, leakage, and multiplicity diagnostics rather than biological interpretation. Generalizability, mechanism, causality, and the opaque meaning of feature_027 remain unresolved.

record.narrative: No assessments are due and validation capacity is exhausted, so this exploration focuses on internal diagnostics of the dominant dataset-specific association and one untested continuous-feature context. The first three proposals complete the feature_057 dose-response check by testing feature_057 10 versus 2 overall and separately within feature_027=0 and feature_027=1 strata. The prior feature_057 contrasts (10 versus 5 and 5 versus 2) did not support a robust negative dose response, but the endpoints are informative: if feature_057 truly marks stronger dependency, the broad 10 versus 2 comparison should show a negative contrast, especially if the pattern is threshold-like. If all these estimates remain small or interval-crossing, the conclusion should be that feature_057 is not a meaningful dose-related modifier or driver of outcome_014. The last three proposals test an untested continuous predictor, feature_010, around the accepted feature_027-outcome_014 association. The hypothesis is that the very large positive feature_027=1 versus feature_027=0 contrast should remain large in both feature_010>=0 and feature_010<=0 strata, with an interaction near zero. If the association remains around +0.8 in both strata and the interaction is small relative to the main effect, this supports stability against an untested continuous context. If one stratum strongly attenuates the main effect or the interaction is clearly larger than the prior background scale, feature_010 should be treated as a potential confounder or effect modifier and investigated with data-quality diagnostics. These claims are dataset-specific associations, not causal or generalizable conclusions. The active broad outcome_014 binary screen H227 through H239 remains scientifically important, but the feature_057 endpoint and feature_010 context tests are useful follow-up on the only robust large effect already observed.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Select up to 12 existing claim references in run_analyses. This requests analyses now; previously tested comparisons reuse their data and give no new sample. Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Assess the newly delivered discovery evidence. Optionally set validate to one eligible claim reference for independent validation; omit it for no request. The controller attaches the discovery result. Validation arrives after this stage.

record.narrative: The delivered screen completes the remaining binary outcome_014 main-effect panel. For most exposures (H228-H236, H238-H239), the signed estimates are small relative to the outcome_014 distribution and their 95% intervals include zero. Several negative estimates (for example feature_042, feature_032, and feature_035) are imprecise and do not provide stable evidence of a meaningful association. I therefore reject the registered positive associations and close these investigations. H237 is different: the signed estimate for feature_006=1 versus feature_006=0 is negative (-0.0647) with an interval that excludes zero, i.e. the evidence contradicts the registered positive direction and points instead toward feature_006=1 being associated with a more negative outcome_014 dependency score. Because H237 was registered as a positive claim, its correct assessment is reject/closed. However, the same evidence is scientifically suggestive of a negative feature_006 association. That signal must remain provisional: it is one nominal finding among 12 newly screened tests (and many earlier tests), so multiplicity is a real concern, and voluntary validation capacity is exhausted. The magnitude is potentially meaningful relative to the background scale of the other tests, but it is far smaller than the dominant feature_027-outcome_014 association and could be confounded by, or masked by, feature_027. I therefore register a reversed negative feature_006 claim and stratum checks within feature_027=0 and feature_027=1 to assess whether the feature_006 signal persists independently of the dominant feature_027 effect. No validation request is made because no new validation requests remain.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator

number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released

It is robust across many binary, categorical, numeric, and eligibility partitions, with estimates commonly near +0.75 to +0.82, for example R126, R127, R129, R130, R131, R132, R158, R159, R174, R175, R177, R178, R180, R181, R185, R186, R210, R211, R215, R216, R218, R219, R221, and R222. The effect is also outcome-specific: analogous feature_027 contrasts on most other dependency scores are small and interval-crossing, and the earlier outcome_013 discovery +0.027 (R150) failed independent validation (-0.010, R153). record.narrative:
The delivered feature_006/feature_027 specificity checks largely resolve the secondary feature_006 signal as not scientifically established, while confirming that the dominant feature_027-outcome_014 association is not appreciably confounded by feature_006. H255 and H256 directly test feature_027=1 versus feature_027=0 separately within feature_006=1 and feature_006=0. Both show very large positive contrasts: H255 signed +0.839 with interval [0.774,0.903] and H256 signed +0.793 with interval [0.772,0.814]. These intervals are wide relative to the small feature_006=1 feature_027=1 cell, but they still exclude zero and are enormous relative to the outcome_014 scale and any plausible 10% relative benchmark. Therefore I accept these as dataset-specific confirmations of the dominant feature_027 association. The complementary interaction H250 has signed estimate +0.0457 and interval [-0.0221,0.1135]; this is consistent with a modest positive interaction by feature_006, but the interval includes zero and the exposed feature_006=1 cell is small. Since this modification is not needed to sustain the main association and cannot be validated, I leave it unresolved and deferred rather than accepting a clinically meaningful interaction claim.

For feature_006 on outcome_014, the overall marginal negative signal from H246/R239 does not survive the planned specificity checks. H247, within feature_027=0, has signed estimate +0.0193 and interval [-0.0094,0.0480]; the raw contrast is in the expected negative direction but imprecise and attenuated relative to the overall signal. H248, within feature_027=1, has signed estimate -0.0264, i.e. the raw contrast is in the opposite direction, with interval crossing zero and a very small exposed cell. The corresponding negative interaction claim H249 is contradicted by the raw positive interaction. Thus the pattern does not support a stable feature_006=1 negative effect independent of feature_027; it is more consistent with marginal confounding, effect heterogeneity, or a small-sample/multiplicity artifact. Because the overall marginal association is still present but not robust across internal strata and cannot be independently validated, I reassess H246 as unresolved and closed rather than accepted.

The outcome-specificity tests also do not support feature_006 as a broad dependency biomarker. For outcome_002, H251, H257, and H258 are not in the negative direction; the signed estimates are negative, so the raw contrasts are positive and interval-crossing, with small or imprecise cells. For outcome_001, H252 is a small raw negative contrast, but the point estimate is modest and the interval crosses zero; given the outcome scale, multiple prior null secondary findings, and no validation capacity, this does not support a meaningful general association. For outcome_008 and outcome_011, H253 and H254 are small interval-crossing estimates. I therefore reject those as evidence for a meaningful negative feature_006 association. Overall, the accepted scientific conclusion remains only the dataset-specific feature_027 association with outcome_014. Feature_006 remains at most a marginal, potentially confounded signal and is not accepted as an independent or generalizable predictor. No validation request is made because no new voluntary validation requests remain.

record.narrative: No assessments are due and no response deadline lists newly released validation; independent validation capacity is exhausted. The final supported finding is an internal, dataset-specific association between feature_027 and outcome_014. The central contrast feature_027=1 versus feature_027=0 on outcome_014 has discovery signed estimate +0.7961 with 95% Welch interval +0.7759 to +0.8163 (R106) and independent validation signed estimate +0.8065 with interval +0.7754 to +0.8376 (R128). Because estimates are signed to the positive hypothesis, feature_027=1 is associated with a much less negative CRISPR dependency score, i.e. weaker measured dependency, on outcome_014. This difference is roughly 0.8 units, about 2.2 standard deviations of outcome_014, and far exceeds the relative-difference benchmark even though relative percentages are awkward when outcomes are near zero. It is robust across many subgroup and eligibility partitions, with estimates commonly near +0.75 to +0.82, and is preserved within feature_006 strata (R250 and R251). The association is outcome-specific: analogous feature_027 contrasts on most other dependency outcomes are small or interval-crossing, and the previously suggestive outcome_013 discovery R150 failed independent validation R153. Feature_006 does not become an accepted secondary finding. Its marginal outcome_014 discovery R239 is suggestive but does not survive internal specificity checks: within feature_027=0 the signal is small and interval-crossing (R242), within feature_027=1 it is opposite in raw direction (R243), the negative interaction claim is contradicted (R244), the complementary feature_027-by-feature_006 interaction is imprecise and positive (R245), and tests on outcome_002, outcome_001, outcome_008, and outcome_011 are inconsistent, small, or interval-crossing (R246 through R249, R252, R253). Thus feature_006 is best interpreted as an unresolved/closed marginal signal potentially confounded by feature_027, chance from a multiplicity-heavy screen, or another data-structure artifact. Most other predictor-outcome comparisons are negative or unsupported: the broad screen found small interval-crossing contrasts for most binary and categorical predictors across most outcomes, and several discovery-positive secondary effects failed independent validation, including feature_065 with outcome_015 (R86 versus R89), feature_063 with outcome_014 (R162 versus R166), feature_005 with outcome_014 within feature_027=0 (R167 versus R173), and feature_055 with outcome_008 in selected strata (R95 versus R102 and R182 versus R185). This supports treating most small nominally significant secondary discoveries as unstable. The major remaining uncertainty is the provenance of the dominant association. Such an outsized, outcome-specific, partition-stable binary association is compatible with data construction, leakage, predictor coding related to outcome_014, assay or batch artifacts, or other dataset-specific structure. The supplied evidence establishes an association only; it does not establish biological mechanism, causal direction, leakage-free behavior, or external generalizability. Pending feature_010 context claims H243 through H245 and feature_057 endpoint claims H240 through H242 are low priority because feature_057 interactions already observed are small relative to the main effect (R217, R220) and feature_027 is highly stable across many continuous and categorical splits. If further internal analyses are selected, completing those tests is useful mainly as additional robustness checks, not as a likely route to new biology. The most informative next investigation would be external or metadata-based validation/provenance auditing of feature_027 and outcome_014; within this dataset, future language should describe feature_027 only as a strong dataset-specific marker of outcome_014 values, not as a causal or generalizable biological predictor.

Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_012 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_005 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_015 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_002 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_016 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_007 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_013 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_014 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_004 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_009 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_010 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_001 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_008 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_003 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_006 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_011 (CRISPR dependency score). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.
